summary: Scoop Mountain (Stevens Co.) had a pole platform tower and tent camp from 1935, abandoned in 1940 and gone; communication towers now stand on the mountain.

facts.design: pole platform tower with tent camp and phone line
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1940; the register and firelookout.com both describe the lookout as gone.

access.note: Gated logging road off Scotts Valley Road; foot traffic only as of 2023 (Willhite). Gate status today not confirmed.

visit.trail_note: Hike of 3.5 miles one way, about 1,800 feet of gain, mostly a road walk from the gate off Scotts Valley Road.

events.note: Pole platform tower, tent camp and phone line placed on the site

notes_for_editor: Build year (1935) and abandonment (1940) agree across the register, firelookout.com and Willhite. No staffing history, fires or photos with usable licences were found, so none are in the story. The restricted access level is an inference from a 2023 gate note on a Willhite page; the gate's current status was not confirmed. The Willhite header lists access as 'Good Gravel Road', so the story no longer calls access limited and states only the 2023 gate. The Willhite caption about communication towers is undated and comes from a visit that may be older than 2023. Access and the hike details come from a single source.
